source_chain: C8=X(8) is the Wiman genus-five curve.
Its full automorphism quotient has signature (2,3,8).
Therefore the compact surface uniformizer is arithmetic and has dense commensurator.
Commensurator elements yield finite holomorphic self-correspondences, so the ambient correspondence universe is infinite and degrees are not uniformly bounded.
ambient_correspondence_finiteness.consequence: Any H5 finiteness must come from the exact MB104 quotient/passport data, not from C8 and etaleness alone.
